title: 第19章 我说这是交通肇事你信么第20章 高人之态
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
子夜，归元山脉外围，一片树林中，一行人正在歇脚。
砰！
一个看起来二十出头的男子，一掌劈在了堆起的木头上，点燃了篝火。
“嘿嘿，鹤老，您看我这一招烈火掌怎么样了？”
男子笑着问道。
身材佝偻的鹤老微微一笑，道：“二十一岁，聚气境二重，还能一掌劈出如此威能的烈火掌，杜邵元你也算是英雄少年了！”
被鹤老夸奖，杜邵元顿时得意起来。
另一边，鹤老转过头，看向他身旁，一个面露愁容的绝美少女。
“大人不必担忧，归元宗夜间封山，等明日拂晓之后，我们就可以上山了。”
鹤老对她说道。
少女苦笑道：“鹤老，您说归元宗……会帮我们么？”
鹤老沉吟道：“归元宗与你们家族一向关系密切，而且还有他们前任宗主的承诺在，我觉得还是会的。”
少女叹口气道：“话虽如此，但毕竟老宗主斯人已逝，人走茶凉啊。”
鹤老没有再说。
因为他也觉得，少女说的有道理。
这件事，太难了。
就在这时……
“呜！”
少女身旁，一只纯白色的小狐狸，忽然翻身而起，对着一处密林龇牙怒吼。
“嗯？小五月，你这是……”

少女一愣。
鹤老却是脸色一凛，高声喝道：“戒备！”
呼！
一瞬间，篝火旁的几十个随从，各个拿起武器，将少女围在正当中。
“鹤老？”
少女愣住。
鹤老低声解释道：“大人，小五月是星眼白狐，是探知能力最强的妖兽之一，能让它如此戒备，显然是有强敌在附近！”
说完，他对着那处密林高声喊道：“阁下，不必躲藏了，请出来相见吧！”
所有人的目光，全都朝着那个方向望去。
“呵呵，想不到，竟然让一只孽畜，察觉到了我的行踪，看来还是我修为不到家啊！”
说话间，一个身材颀长，满头红发的男子，缓步走了出来。
“阁下是谁？”
鹤老看着他，沉声问道。
红发男子却没有回答，他的目光在众人身上掠过，最终落在了少女身上。
“哦？”
男子眼中，闪过一抹亮光。
“哈哈，极品！
极品啊！
想不到，小小的夜风国，竟然会有一个姿容气度如此出类拔萃之人，看来一会儿我玩弄你的时候，可要小心一点，否则万一弄死了，就太可惜了。”
content_en:
At midnight, on the outskirts of the Guiyuan Mountains, a group of people were resting in a forest.
Bang!
A man who looked to be in his early twenties struck the piled wood with his palm and lit the bonfire.
"Hey, Mr. He, what do you think of my Fire Palm move?"
the man asked with a smile.
The stooped He Lao smiled slightly and said: "Twenty-one years old, at the second level of the Qi Gathering Realm, and you can also split such a powerful fire palm with one palm. Du Shaoyuan, you can be considered a heroic young man!"
Being praised by Mr. He, Du Shaoyuan suddenly became proud.
On the other side, Mr. He turned his head and looked at the beautiful girl with a sad face next to him.
"Sir, don't worry. Guiyuan Sect has closed the mountain at night. We can go up the mountain after dawn tomorrow."
Mr. He said to her.
The girl smiled bitterly and said: "Mr. He, do you think Guiyuan Sect...will help us?"
Mr. He muttered: "Guiyuan Sect has always had a close relationship with your family, and there is also the promise of their former sect master. I think it will happen."
The girl sighed and said, "That being said, after all, the old sect master has passed away. It's time to leave."
Mr. He said nothing more.
Because he also felt that what the girl said made sense.
This matter is too difficult.
Just then...
"Woo!"
Next to the girl, a pure white little fox suddenly turned over and roared at a dense forest.
"Huh? Little May, what are you..."
The girl was stunned.
However, Mr. He had a stern look on his face and shouted loudly: "Be alert!"
Phew!
In an instant, dozens of followers around the campfire each picked up their weapons and surrounded the girl.
"He Lao?"
The girl was stunned.
Mr. He explained in a low voice: "Sir, Xiao Wuyue is a star-eyed white fox. It is one of the monster beasts with the strongest detection ability. To make it so alert, there is obviously a strong enemy nearby!"
After saying that, he shouted loudly towards the dense forest: "Your Excellency, there is no need to hide, please come out and meet us!"
Everyone's eyes were all looking in that direction.
"Haha, I didn't expect that an evil beast actually noticed my whereabouts. It seems that my cultivation is not good enough!"
While talking, a tall man with red hair walked out slowly.
"Who is your Excellency?"
Mr. He looked at him and asked in a deep voice.
The red-haired man did not answer. His eyes passed over everyone and finally landed on the girl.
"Oh?"
A light flashed in the man's eyes.
"Haha, excellent!
Excellent!
I never expected that there would be a person with such outstanding appearance and bearing in the small Night Wind Kingdom. It seems that I have to be careful when I play with you later, otherwise it would be a pity if I get killed. "
